signals_info.description: Whether traction control is actively intervening.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition tcs_active == 1 shall cease to be true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，tcs_active == 1 这一条件应刚停止成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Traction control shall end its intervention at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 牵引力控制系统应在未来某个时刻结束介入。
